semantic_spot_checks.sea: USA300 MRSA is presented as a necrotizing-fasciitis pathogen; the SEA does not convert this to population-level causal evidence.
Initial BP 58/32 mm Hg, WBC 1,600/µL, vancomycin MIC 2 µg/mL, CD4 <20 cells/mm³, and HIV viral load 358,000 copies/mL match the source.
The SEA preserves uncertainty about PVL/ACME causality and the therapeutic significance of clindamycin resistance/increased vancomycin MIC.
Histopathology, susceptibility values, and the 20-case comparison are represented consistently with the source.
